aboutText: Based in Montmorency, Lux Kitchen Joinery has been transforming homes with custom kitchen, laundry, and wardrobe solutions for over a decade. Our team specialises in precision craftsmanship, ensuring every detail meets your expectations. We serve the local community with reliable and professional joinery services. With a focus on quality materials and innovative design, we bring your vision to life.
servicesText: We offer a range of joinery services tailored to your needs, from kitchen installations to custom wardrobes. Our expertise ensures high-quality finishes and functional designs for every project.
